bark-grain.jpg.derivation: A crop of the scan's diffuse map, high-passed to its fine grain and made tileable (256 x 512). Not any species' bark: the plates, fissures and fibres of each species' bark are drawn by vegetation-geometry.mjs (BARK_STYLES) and this grain laid over them.
